script_text: Virgo, Mercury is about to completely rewrite your entire week ahead. Monday brings Mercury square Saturn in your tenth house, pressuring career and money decisions at work. Tuesday gets confusing as Mercury opposes Jupiter in your seventh house, clouding love talks. Wednesday improves as Venus trines Mercury in your first house, boosting confidence and charm. Thursday shifts when Mercury enters your fourth house and sextiles Mars in your sixth house. Friday through Sunday, Moon conjunct Venus in your fifth house sparks romance and creativity. An ex may return testing your standards, while Sunday Jupiter trines your Sun in your ninth house. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Mercury in your first house. Tuesday is your worst day because Mercury opposes Jupiter in your seventh house. Write everything down, organize one priority daily, and trust your Earth sign intuition completely. Follow for daily updates.
